expected_level_description: You can: - advise managers on job design, selection methods, and fair assessment - design assessments for specialist roles, such as technical exercises for digital roles - analyse recruitment data to improve time to hire, quality, and diversity - manage the candidate experience and the employer brand

You can: - write adverts that appeal to specialist candidates and use plain language - search job boards, professional networks, and talent pools for candidates - support events, such as careers fairs and open days

You can: - prepare contracts, variation letters, and employment checks accurately - process changes in the HR and payroll system against deadlines - answer routine questions from managers and staff about HR processes
You can: - apply people policies to routine cases and explain them to managers - identify the employment law principles behind a policy - keep policy records and track policy review dates
You can: - run standard workforce reports and check them for errors - answer routine information requests about the workforce
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
You can: - recognise and challenge behaviour that excludes others - consider different needs when you plan your work
